description: This source file contains a function to retrieve the current used CPU memory of the process on Linux systems by parsing /proc/self/status for VmRSS and VmSwap entries.

methods.name: SearchForMemoryValue
methods.description: Searches for a specific memory value in the buffer by key, extracts the number following the key, and returns the value in bytes.

methods.name: SbSystemGetUsedCPUMemory
methods.description: Reads /proc/self/status, parses VmRSS and VmSwap entries, and returns the total used memory in bytes.
